notes: Second pen (12v l.11 after the naskh word 'والثاني', l.12, l.13; segmenter lines 11-13 of image 0084_0029). By eye 8+14+11 = 33 signs (record 8,13,11 = 32) and 9 dividers (record 11): two in row 11, three in row 12, four in row 13 (the last at its left end). 9 groups of 4,2,7,4,3,3,4,4,2 signs (group 3 runs over the row 11/12 end; group 6 over the row 12/13 end). Most signs are drawn as Arabic letters (ع ص و ح ط ب م ک), plus ٥, o, 8, Δ, a ring with a dot and a لا-like V. Row 12 ends with a stem carrying one dot (S16, a letter sign); left of it a grey smudge running down the margin is offset/stain, not counted. In row 13 the ring (S13) between ص and < is greyer than the ink around it; counted as a sign, could be a paper flaw. 17 shapes for 33 signs; sign values unknown.
